test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully and decide which conclusion(s) is/are implicit in the statement.

Statement:

No nation is completely self-dependent these days.

Conclusions:

I. Citizens of the country have become lazy.

II. It is impossible to grow and produce all that a nation needs.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II is implicit.
Both Conclusion I and II are implicit.

solution:
The statement 'No nation is completely self-dependent these days' implies that no nation is completely self-reliant. 

Conclusions:

I. Citizens of the country have become lazy.→ The cause of the dependency cannot be determined from the statement. Therefore, we cannot conclude that citizens have become lazy.

II. It is impossible to grow and produce all that a nation needs. → Since **no nation** is able to rely on itself for all its needs, it can be safely concluded that it is not possible to be self-reliant or produce all that a country needs by itself.

Hence, only conclusion II is implicit.
